summary: Complete testing of participant reviews feature. All 22 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend participant detail pages show reviews with 'Показать ещё' button working correctly. Admin panel has participant filter and selector in review form. Mobile responsiveness verified.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/participants/marina-svetlova/reviews returns 12 reviews with correct participant_slug
Backend: GET /api/participants/aleksandr-volkov/reviews returns 12 reviews
Backend: All 8 participants have exactly 12 reviews each
Backend: Reviews have required fields (author_name, author_city, text, rating, participant_slug)
Backend: Reviews have valid ratings (1-5)
Backend: Non-existent participant returns empty reviews list
Backend: Only published reviews returned in public API
Backend: Admin reviews list includes participant_slug field (96 total reviews)
Backend: POST /api/admin/reviews with participant_slug creates linked review
Backend: PUT /api/admin/reviews/{id} updates review including participant_slug (moves between participants)
Backend: Review without participant_slug creates unlinked general review
Backend: Admin can filter reviews by participant_slug (client-side filtering)
Backend: Admin participants list returns all 8 participants for filter dropdown
Backend: Review texts are meaningful (>50 chars)
Backend: Review cities are populated
Backend: Different participants have unique reviews (no duplicates)
Frontend: /uchastniki/marina-svetlova shows reviews section with title 'Отзывы о работе Марина'
Frontend: Initially shows 5 review cards with author name, city, rating stars, text
Frontend: 'Показать ещё (7)' button visible when more than 5 reviews
Frontend: After clicking 'Показать ещё' all 12 reviews visible in DOM
Frontend: Button hidden after showing all reviews
Frontend: /uchastniki/aleksandr-volkov shows correct reviews for that participant (different authors)
Frontend: Admin /admin/reviews shows participant column in table
Frontend: Admin filter dropdown shows all 8 participants with counts (12 each)
Frontend: Admin filter dropdown has 'Все отзывы', 'Без привязки' options
Frontend: Admin review form has 'Привязать к участнику' participant selector
Frontend: Form participant selector has 9 options (8 participants + 'Без привязки')
Frontend: Mobile viewport (390x844) shows reviews correctly with all elements
Frontend: Mobile 'Показать ещё' button works correctly
